status: x-y-time-only fine-horizontal feasibility preflight frozen before fine-route-conditioned vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: At what finer horizontal grain can the already-frozen three-state movement conditioning be combined with place matching while retaining enough evaluable individuals in all five comparative panels?

movement_state.assignment: endpoint fix of each valid step

feasibility.target_support: A state-valid target event is structurally supported when its fine horizontal cell × movement-state pair occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and at least one retained session of another individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported target events
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first (finest) candidate for which every primary panel retains at least 70% of its movement-state-conditioned evaluable individuals and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, do not open the fine-route vertical outcome.

planned_test_if_feasible.route_habitat_hypothesis: Within-state vertical individuality is largely generated because individuals repeatedly use different fine-scale horizontal routes or patches with different vertical opportunities.
planned_test_if_feasible.within_matched_stratum_hypothesis: Vertical individuality persists after self and other profiles are compared under identical fine-cell × movement-state weights.
planned_test_if_feasible.vertical_test: Reuse session-median centered vertical residuals and the frozen whole-session permutation scheme. Replace the 5-km horizontal cell in the movement-state-conditioned estimator with the selected fine cell.
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight evaluable n, calibrated observed-minus-null-mean identity >0, and one-sided p(null >= observed)<=0.05

stop_rule: Do not change candidate order, 70% retention rule, >=5 floor, >=50 target-event support, movement-state definition or support definition after preflight output is opened.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes while selecting horizontal grain.
If no fine cell passes, stop rather than lowering support thresholds.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
